digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design, Data

stories.headline: Apple's 20B Model Achieves Extreme Memory Efficiency
stories.blurb: Apple demonstrated a 20-billion-parameter on-device model that keeps most weights in flash storage to run within 2GB of RAM, enabling drastically lower energy consumption on consumer hardware.

stories.headline: Dessa Demonstrates Speech-Only Conversational AI
stories.blurb: Dessa introduced a real-time conversational model trained directly on raw audio without text representations, capable of laughing on cue, following audio instructions, and retaining knowledge from pure sound.

stories.headline: SpaceX Secures $40 Billion Debt Deal for GPUs
stories.blurb: SpaceX finalized $40 billion in off-balance-sheet debt financing through a special purpose vehicle to purchase AI chips, securing computing capacity ahead of scheduled 2027 deliveries.

stories.headline: Critical PHP Bugs Expose Web Infrastructure
stories.blurb: Two unauthenticated remote code execution flaws in PHP triggered emergency patching across major web platforms as active exploitation spiked.

stories.headline: Brotli Library Flaw Threatens Cloud Environments
stories.blurb: A critical remote code execution flaw in the Brotli decompression library impacts Node.js, Bun, and Envoy, exposing up to 91% of tested cloud environments.

stories.headline: AWS MCP Python Sandbox Bypassed via Match/Case Flaw
stories.blurb: Security researchers bypassed AWS's managed MCP Python sandbox using implicit attribute reads in match/case patterns to execute arbitrary commands inside the container.

stories.headline: AWS Large Capacity Booked Solid Through 2027
stories.blurb: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy announced that major cloud capacity commitments are booked through 2027 due to unprecedented AI demand, though on-demand availability remains intact.

stories.headline: OpenAI Details Storage System Scaling to 1B Users
stories.blurb: OpenAI revealed architectural updates to its Habitat platform, which manages over 500 petabytes on Azure Cosmos DB using request priorities and serverless features to eliminate hot-key outages.

stories.headline: Railway Discloses Intrusion Targeting AI Credentials
stories.blurb: PaaS provider Railway reported a security breach where attackers accessed internal systems to harvest AI provider API keys across roughly 100,000 workspaces.

stories.headline: Lance Format Challenges Parquet for AI Access Patterns
stories.blurb: The Lance file format uses point-retrieval optimization to drastically outperform Parquet when querying random vector embeddings and multimodal data.

stories.headline: Canva Unveils Layout-Aware Craft Image Model
stories.blurb: Canva introduced Craft, an in-house generative image model that plans composition and typography before rendering high-resolution, editable design layouts.

stories.headline: Study Shows Most Top Sites Rely on Single Font Families
stories.blurb: An analysis of over 2,000 top design websites revealed that 60% rely entirely on scale and weight variations within a single typeface rather than multi-font pairings.

stories.headline: dquickts Runtime Serializes JS Execution Mid-Loop
stories.blurb: A specialized QuickJS fork allows programs to pause mid-loop, serialize execution state to disk, and resume across process boundaries with zero runtime dependencies.
